reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass: Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding; public API exception also applies). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions field in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json — cannot trigger. Gate 3: market.move is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is confirmed — register_market takes no XOracle parameter and enforces no oracle check at listing time. Attack path is clear (admin registers market without feed → users deposit → withdrawal aborts via get_price_with_check → funds locked), but requires admin misconfiguration rather than direct attacker action, yielding CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL at Medium.
